risks.title: Economic risk and macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 200 countries and is affected by general economic conditions, inflation, unemployment, consumer spending, and international trade policies (Item 1A). Impact documented in 2025 with trade policy volatility reducing volumes on China-US trade lanes.

risks.title: Increased competition and market share erosion
risks.score_rationale: The company faces growing competition from new technology and logistics players in a rapidly transforming sector (Item 1A). Particularly relevant with voluntary volume reduction from largest customer (Amazon).

risks.title: Major customer dependence and volume loss
risks.score_rationale: The company has strategically reduced Amazon exposure with targeted 50% volume reduction by June 2026 (Item 1A and MDA). This historical dependence remains a significant concentration risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces significant cybersecurity risks due to intensive information technology use, third-party interactions, and critical nature of logistics operations (Item 1A). Potential severe impact on customer data and operational continuity.

risks.title: Strike and labor slowdown risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces strike and slowdown risks via collective bargaining negotiations with employees critical to operations (Item 1A). Recent labor agreements finalized in 2023.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces evolving regulatory risks including data protection, cybersecurity, environmental regulations, and labor standards (Item 1A). Impact on operating costs and innovation capacity.

ai_positioning.summary: UPS does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies as key focus areas in its 2025 fiscal year 10-K. Technology initiatives concentrate on RFID, network automation, and logistics flow optimization via sensing technologies, without mention of generative AI or machine learning.
